run_remote_hello_robot_server: run the Pyro4 remote Hello Robot server on a given IP address
create_remote_hello_robot_instance: create a RemoteHelloRobot instance that connects to a Stretch robot via ROS
go_to_absolute_position: move the robot base to an absolute (x, y, yaw) position in the world frame
go_to_relative_position: move the robot base to a relative (x, y, yaw) offset from its current pose
get_camera_transform: get the camera transform matrix from the camera color frame to the robot base link
